commit.message:
fix(scheduling): booking and expiry pushes show fixed lock-screen copy (B-714-1, B-653-1)

Every booking push (requested, booked, confirmed, declined, cancelled,
moved, move requested, 24h and 1h reminders, call link needed/ready,
request closed) now shows a fixed per-kind title and body on the lock
screen: no display name, no coach-written session type name, no notes or
reasons. A reminder keeps only its time in the recipient's zone (no time
when no usable zone). The inbox row inside the app is unchanged and keeps
the full detail. Wording matches the push stack's lock-screen-copy.ts
(B-692-1), so routing through its sender keeps the same copy.

Tests: new test/booking-lock-screen-push.spec.ts drives all 14 emitter
calls with canary names, type names, notes and reasons; existing specs
that asserted the old push text now assert the lock-screen line and read
the detail from the inbox row.

fix(scheduling): a client move request says a time change is requested on the coach lock screen (B-653-4)

emitMoveRequested keeps the booking_rescheduled kind but nothing has moved
until the coach approves, so its push uses its own fixed line: title
'Time change requested', body 'A client asked to move a session. Open the
app to review.' A real move (emitRescheduled) still says 'Session moved'.
No names, no coach-written text.

Test: test/booking-lock-screen-push.spec.ts B-653-4 (fails before, passes
after); the all-emitters table now pins the move-request line.
